full_judgment: 32. Moreover, keeping the present respondents No. 1-3 uninformed, the present appellants also mutated their name in the khatian as regards to the property belonged to Abdur Rashid vide mutation case No. 426/1996-97 on 14-1-1997. However, having been informed about the said fact the present respondent No. 1 filed a case for cancelling the said mutation which was registered as miscellaneous case No. 15 of 2002 and the assistant commissioner (land) eventually by his order dated 6-11-2002 cancelled the said mutation case obtained fraudulently by the appellants.
